cover.kicker: 封面故事 · GitHub 项目
cover.title:
t3code 近四天日增翻了近一倍
已连续 37 天达标
cover.dek: t3code 近 4 天官方日增从 +1,530 涨到 +3,028，已连续 37 天达标。它是一处管理多个编码 Agent 的控制台，涨得最快，但第三方的真实使用讨论还不多。
cover.title_en:
t3code's daily stars nearly doubled in four days
and the streak is now 37 days
cover.dek_en: Over the last four days t3code's official daily gain climbed from +1,530 to +3,028, extending a 37-day streak. It's a console for running several coding agents in one place, and it's growing fastest of the lot, though there's little independent talk about real use yet.

stickers.title: 新官方
stickers.text: gemini-api-cli 日增 +1,106，此前日增都没超过 6。
stickers.text_en: gemini-api-cli gained +1,106 stars today, after never topping 6 a day before.

stickers.title: 论文角
stickers.text: LEDGER+EP 用 1% 上下文，与全量回放同为 74.8%。
stickers.text_en: LEDGER+EP matches full replay at 74.8% on LongMemEval using 1% of the context.

stickers.title: 冷眼看
stickers.text: 多数增长榜项目在 X 上几乎没有真实讨论，增长来自趋势榜和 YouTube。
stickers.text_en: Most fast-growing repos get almost no real discussion on X; the stars come from trending lists and YouTube.
